functions.name: init
functions.description: Attaches the ribbon to open and future compose windows if config.ribbon is true and returns the available features.

functions.name: updateConfig
functions.description: Applies a new config to every open compose window.

functions.name: getFeatures
functions.description: Returns whether the compose ribbon is available.

events.name: onStateChanged
events.description: Fired with the ribbon's UI state when the user changes it.

events.name: onDefaultStyleSetChanged
events.description: Fired with a style set key when the user makes it the default for new mails.
